title: The Tide Bell
text: When the tide turns, a bell rings under the water, sweet and lonely. The sea people say it calls home anyone who hears it. The shore is lined with footprints walking into the waves, and none walk out.

options.label: The one with the sea in them answers the bell, trusting it to let them go.

outcomes.text: They come back with salt in their hair and calm in their eyes.
They very nearly do not come back. They return harder for it.

options.label: The hardiest dives for the bell to silence its call for good.

outcomes.text: They bring up old bronze, heavy with essence.
The sea people take it badly.

options.label: Stop your ears and go before anyone walks into the waves.

outcomes.text: It rings anyway in your dreams. In them, you walk toward it.
